_comment: Maple Bank (fictional) card dispute rules: the hard limits from the Card Dispute Policy, read by evaluate_dispute_rules. The policy document states the same numbers in words; CI checks they match. The version that applies is the one in force on the transaction date.

required_evidence: Two posted charges with the same merchant, amount and date
Receipt or quote showing the agreed amount
incorrect_amount.notes: Differences caused by currency conversion and the conversion fee are not errors.

required_evidence: Proof of return or cancellation (return slip)
No matching refund in the card history

cancelled_recurring.notes: Only charges dated after the cancellation are credited.

required_evidence: Order confirmation with the expected delivery date
not_received.notes: Not eligible before the expected delivery date has passed.

required_evidence: The customer's history with the merchant
unauthorised.notes: If the history shows the customer's own regular purchases, explain the statement descriptor. Otherwise send the case to the fraud team; the disputes team does not decide fraud.
